platforms.name: Browser extension (Chromium)
platforms.notes: The packaged zip strips the development key; the Chrome Web Store ID will differ from the unpacked ID. 1.2.2 ships the expanded 239,885-domain core tier (480 static rules) from seed v5.

platforms.name: Mac
platforms.state: development · unsigned, needs Developer ID and notarization
platforms.notes: Every target must carry the same MARKETING_VERSION and CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION; 1.1.6 bundles seed v5 and its expanded core tier while keeping the guardian-daemon packaging.

platforms.name: iPhone & iPad
platforms.state: development · no Apple team, Family Controls entitlement or test device
platforms.notes: The app, six Safari blockers and HisnActivityMonitor share one version set; 1.1.4 raises Safari capacity from four to six 40,000-rule parts and bundles seed v5 (239,885 domains).

platforms.name: Android
platforms.state: preview · unsigned; direct builds add the -direct suffix
platforms.notes: versionCode is monotonic and must increase for every uploaded or side-loaded update. 24 lets the daily schedule block every app except a chosen keep list, and adds the browser-coverage screen from 23.
